title: Days of the Week
label: ch:ka-days-of-the-week
canDo: I can name any day of the week in Kannada, including the Sunday that uses a different sun-name from Hindi's.

payoff.summary: Complete KA-C10-checkpoint, the chapter's closing checkpoint: say the seven days from sōmavāra to bhānuvāra and name the sun-name that differs from Hindi's, find ◌ೋ in ಸೋಮವಾರ and read ೨ as eraḍu, then write both from sound.
payoff.note: KA-C10-checkpoint (sequence 389, KA-PATH-013 order 1, after KA-S141-digit-two and before chapter 11's first lesson) assesses all three atoms the chapter introduces (3/3). It is the payoff because two of them, ◌ೋ (KA-S119-vowel-sign-oo, 385) and ೨ (KA-S141-digit-two, 387), are taught after the spoken lesson KA-C10-vaara (380), which could honestly assess only the weekdays (1/3); KA-C10-vaara stays as the chapter's spoken lesson. Both script lessons sit on earlier path segments (KA-PATH-100, KA-PATH-011), so the checkpoint comes after all three on the sequence and on the path.
